events.text:
## 📐 REST API Specification: Enterprise Resource Model

> **Orchestrator Notice**: Mode is set to `PLAN`. The Captain and Crewmate sub-agents completed OpenAPI specification design without mutating workspace files.

---

### 🌐 Endpoint Matrix

| Verb | Resource Path | Description | Status Code |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/items` | Create new item resource | `201 Created` |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/items` | List items with cursor pagination | `200 OK` |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/items/{id}` | Fetch item by ID | `200 OK` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/v1/items/{id}` | Partial item update | `200 OK` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/items/{id}` | Delete item resource | `204 No Content` |

---

### 📦 RFC-7807 Standard Error Envelope

```json
{
  "type": "https://api.example.com/errors/not-found",
  "title": "Resource Not Found",
  "status": 404,
  "detail": "Item with ID 42 was not found in the workspace repository.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/items/42"
}
```

---

*Switch mode to **BUILD** (`Shift+M` or `/mode build`) to generate router implementation files!*
